letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. I still marvel at how you turn ordinary moments into sparkle—your laugh, your gentle touch, your unstoppable love. As we walk hand‑in‑hand through bustling souks and quiet garden paths, my heart beats louder for you, my cutie. Thank you for being my forever adventure, my home, my endless inspiration. I love you more with each passing day.
poem:
In desert gold and mango hue,  
Your smile paints the sky anew.  
Across the miles, our hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
